name: deadline_reaches_the_provider
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. In a scope with no timeout, one of 10 seconds, of half a second, and of more than the cap, call seen.
expected: The provider sees a deadline exactly when the scope has a timeout, over both transports.

name: deadline_passed_before_the_call
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. In a scope with a timeout of zero or less, call deposit of 1 on a new account. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: Each leg fails with timeout and is never sent: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: deadline_passed_in_the_scope
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. In a scope with a timeout of 0.2 seconds call stall. 2. In the same scope call deposit of 1 on a new account. 3. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: Both calls fail with timeout, the second without being sent: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: deadline_passed_leaves_the_next_scope_fit
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. In a scope with a timeout of 0.1 seconds call stall. 2. In a new scope with a timeout of 10 seconds call deposit of 3 on a new account. 3. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: The first call fails with timeout; the second returns a total of 3 over both transports.
